{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
rm -rf temp_workspace/*

# Produce recursive listing of /working
if [ -e /working ]; then
  find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace/listing.txt || true
else
  :> temp_workspace/listing.txt
fi

# Extract entries whose final component is "workspace"
awk -F'/' '$NF=="workspace" {print}' temp_workspace/listing.txt > temp_workspace/candidates.txt

# Obtain file-type metadata for each candidate
:> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if stat_out=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null); then
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$stat_out" >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
  else
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" 'not found' >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt

# Normalize candidate paths to absolute form and remove duplicates
:> temp_workspace/candidates_clean.txt
if [ -s temp_workspace/candidates.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -z "$p" ] && continue
    rp=$(realpath -m -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$p")
    printf '%s\n' "$rp"
  done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt | sort -u > temp_workspace/candidates_clean.txt
fi

# Determine for each candidate whether it is a regular file
:> temp_workspace/verification.txt
if [ -s temp_workspace/candidates_clean.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -z "$p" ] && continue
    t=$(awk -F'\t' -v path="$p" '$1==path{print $2; exit}' temp_workspace/metadata.txt)
    if [ -z "$t" ]; then
      if stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; then
        t=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p")
      else
        t="not found"
      fi
    fi
    if [ "$t" = "regular file" ]; then
      printf '%s\tyes\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace/verification.txt
    else
      printf '%s\tno\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace/verification.txt
    fi
  done < temp_workspace/candidates_clean.txt
fi

# Create or remove marker flag
if grep -q -P '\tyes$' temp_workspace/verification.txt 2>/dev/null; then
  touch temp_workspace/found_regular.flag
else
  rm -f temp_workspace/found_regular.flag
fi

# Prepare final decision without emitting it
if [ -e temp_workspace/found_regular.flag ]; then
  printf 'yes' > temp_workspace/decision.txt
else
  printf 'no' > temp_workspace/decision.txt
fi
"}
